newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh Aziz Pipes offers bonus, rights share.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh Aziz Pipes offers bonus, rights share.

text.p: Bangladesh's Aziz Pipes Ltd (APL) is to offer rights shares worth more than 126 million taka to finance an expansion programme, company officials said on Wedndesday.
The company, which produces PVC (plastic polyvinyl chloride) pipes, has also proposed a one-for-two bonus share for the year ended on December 31.
"We are building a modern manufacturing unit to produce PVC sheet under the extension programme," company official Ismat Doha told Reuters.
The company will issue one rights share for each share held by investors at 650 taka per rights share.
The project cost will be around 300 million taka, and the rest of the financing will come from the company's own resources, Doha said.
The company is the largest manufacturer of PVC in the country. The 100-taka APL share was trading at 2,723.58 taka on the Dhaka Stock Exchange on Tuesday.
